content: On the Hour, Level Six (the lettrists) likewise hold that all things return to their source, but in a holy, heavenly form wholly transcendent and divested of the taint of the body and of the usages of creation: the 29 letters revealed to the Seal (counting lām-alif as a letter). When the meanings of those letters manifest free of transcription and extraneous accretions, all that is, from pre-eternity to post-eternity, becomes manifest and nothing remains hidden.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
